given: a SKU's stock record carries its combined tracking code (inventory_code)
when: the operator views that SKU's detail view
then: the record's tracking code is shown alongside its location and quantity

independence.rationale: AC1 asserts the per-location rows and their location/quantity exist; AC2 adds the distinct outcome that each record's combined tracking code is displayed, which can break (code omitted) while the location/quantity rows still render correctly.

architectural_notes: E2E: outcome is the SPA displaying each record's combined inventory_code alongside its location and quantity, derived from the real detail response. Boundary app/routes/ returns the code as JSON (repository reads the NOT NULL inventory_code column, PI2); the client renders it. Client-server contract verified end-to-end against the paired branch so the actual wire shape carrying the tracking code is exercised, not a stubbed prop. No new persistence invariant.
